subject.title: fix(agents): treat codex exec_command as exec-like

question: Should this PR require live Codex app-server proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly override the real-behavior proof gate for the source-contract-plus-tests evidence?
rationale: The code direction looks right, but ClawSweeper cannot treat focused tests and sibling Codex source inspection as external-contributor real behavior proof for the exact warning delivery path.

options.title: Require live proof and refresh
options.body: Ask for a rebase plus redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, linked artifact, or recording that shows the read-only and mutating `exec_command` warning cases after the patch.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the Codex source contract and focused OpenClaw tests despite the missing live app-server turn.

options.title: Pause or close later
options.body: If no live or producer-path evidence appears after the proof window and no new check activity keeps the branch active, maintainers can close or replace the PR.

recommendation.title: Require live proof and refresh
recommendation.body: Ask for a rebase plus redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, linked artifact, or recording that shows the read-only and mutating `exec_command` warning cases after the patch.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle already routed narrower related attempts back to this broader fix path and is the clearest review-history owner for the proof-sufficiency choice.
